mode: OFFLINE reference-query regression only; NOT an LLM accuracy result

rows.question: What is total revenue?
rows.sql: SELECT SUM(quantity*unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items

rows.question: How many orders are there?
rows.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders

rows.question: Show revenue by category
rows.sql: SELECT p.category,SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON i.product_id=p.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category

rows.question: Which region generates the most revenue?
rows.sql: SELECT c.region,SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price) AS revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id=i.order_id GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

rows.question: Show monthly revenue
rows.sql: SELECT SUBSTR(o.order_date,1,7) AS month,SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id=i.order_id GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

rows.question: List customers with no orders
rows.sql: SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL ORDER BY c.customer_id

rows.question: What is the average order value?
rows.sql: SELECT AVG(total) AS average_order_value FROM (SELECT order_id,SUM(quantity*unit_price) AS total FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id)

rows.question: Which product sold the most units?
rows.sql: SELECT p.name,SUM(i.quantity) AS units FROM products p JOIN order_items i ON p.product_id=i.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 1

rows.question: How many customers are in each region?
rows.sql: SELECT region,COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customers GROUP BY region ORDER BY region

rows.question: Show orders worth more than 500
rows.sql: SELECT order_id,SUM(quantity*unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING SUM(quantity*unit_price)>500 ORDER BY order_id

rows.question: Show revenue for Electronics
rows.sql: SELECT SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON i.product_id=p.product_id WHERE p.category='Electronics'

rows.question: Show total units sold
rows.sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) AS units FROM order_items
